item.title: Fire destroys barn near Hume
item.description: Shortly after 1:00 p.m. on Wednesday, the Rich Hill and Foster Fire Departments were dispatched to assist the Hume Fire Department with a structure fire located south of Hume on V Highway.Agencies that responded include Hume Fire Department , Foster fire department , Rich Hill Missouri Fire Department, The Bates County Sheriff's Office as well as Bates County EMS.The building is considered a total loss and the exact cause is yet to be determined. #MidAmericaLive

item.title: MU Extension offers tips regarding affordable child care
item.description: Accessible and affordable child care is crucial for both families and Missour's economy. When parents struggle to find quality care, they may reduce work hours or leave jobs, resulting in significant losses for businesses and communities. Reliable child care keeps parents in the workforce and provides children with essential early learning experiences. MU Extension and others are working with providers to expand and improve quality child care options statewide. Learn more: https://brnw.ch/21x04c
